verdict.rationale: Rootly documents programmatic access that could serve as a do-it-yourself extraction path: an authenticated REST API with API keys, a public JSON API for status page and incident data, and an MCP server that can query incidents and on-call schedules. Nothing documents a bulk or self-serve export of all account data in open formats, and the migration docs cover only moving into Rootly from PagerDuty/Opsgenie, not leaving. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, open-format export of schedules/escalation policies/retrospectives/timelines, an outbound migration or offboarding path, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.
